name: Weed Firm 2: Back to College
storyline:
Join expelled botany student Ted Growing as he returns to his Alma Mater. There, he sets up the ultimate grass grow-op in an abandoned gym. As Ted, immerse yourself in the world of cultivating and selling cannabis, expanding your weed farm with new bud varieties and magical mushrooms. Experience the excitement of managing your buzz, growing your pot farm empire, and serving an ever-increasing client base that demands respect and quality bud.

The Hashienda Vault adds a new dimension to your farming experience. This hidden gem allows you to refine your hash-making skills and bubble hash techniques, enhancing the depth and profitability of your farm. It's an essential addition for anyone serious about staying on top of the weed farm game.

Embark on this cultivation journey with Ted, making strategic choices that affect your farm's success. Outwit the law, diversify your offerings, and keep expanding your clientele. Focus on growing the best bud and maintaining your reign in the weed farm empire.

Jah be with you! Peace
summary:
Weed Firm 2: Back to College, a Bud Farm Tycoon game by Manitoba Games.

Welcome back to the legendary adventure of weed growing with Weed Firm 2: Back to College. This sequel takes the farm simulation of selling pot to new heights, building on the legacy of the original Weed Firm: RePlanted.

In this plant game, you will:
• Cultivate your weed farm empire with renowned strains like White Widow, Purple Haze, and the potent Alien Weed.
• Be introduced to the Hashienda Vault, an underground sanctuary for crafting hash and bubble hash, and meeting unique customers.
• Market your top-quality bud to a diverse group of eccentric clients, including special customer Soulja Boy - Big Draco!
• Customize your shop with various items to enhance your farm's buzz and security, safeguarding your cannabis.
• Broaden your grass business with magic mushrooms, blunts, rosin dabs, wax, and edibles.
• Explore interstellar trade by opening a shop in the Space Bar, selling high-profit concentrates to alien visitors.
• Defend your stash of ‘shrooms and mary jane from Gangbangers and evade corrupt cops and federal agents who are after your bud farm.
• Expand your weed farm to new horizons, discovering secrets within the RV and beyond.
